mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the sensory endings made the skin feel like more than a covering: the result brought together its nerves, blood vessels and sweat gland.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to join the two skin layers before adding blood vessels was confusing. The result didn't explain the missing prerequisite.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the dermis needed blood vessels before it could join the outer layer; inspecting it revealed and automatically performed that step.

arbitrary.text: The requirement to add vessels before joining the layers felt a bit arbitrary: the pictures showed where the layers belonged, but not why that order was required.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: connecting the skin's different parts to the body was interesting, although I'd hope prerequisites were clearer.
